responsibility: Describes the Epiphany processor pipeline to GCC’s DFA scheduler. It defines the instruction-issue and FPU automata, dual-issue and pairing restrictions, reservation latencies for integer ALU, loads, stores, branches, calls, scalar FP, and vector FP operations, plus bypass relationships and a sched_use_fpu attribute used by peephole logic. This file therefore owns the target’s instruction timing and resource-conflict model rather than the instruction semantics themselves.
